A.claim: At p=3: if 3 divides none of A,B,C and 3 divides both x and y, then C^z = 2 or 7 mod 9, and consequently 3 does not divide z. Elementary (the cubes among units mod 9 are exactly {1,8}), independent of FLT3.

B.claim: Exact reduction of the sparsest mod-72 class (x,y even, z odd): a counterexample there is exactly a coprime opposite-parity pair (u,v) with Re((u+vi)^z) and Im((u+vi)^z) both perfect powers (exponents >= 2), and C = u^2+v^2. Derivation: C is odd (kernel-verified not_both_exponents_even_of_even_C), so a+bi, a-bi are coprime in the UFD Z[i]; units ar
